info.name: Door cycle Extra Trees
info.description: Detects timestamp-gap cycle boundaries, then classifies learned current, voltage, back-EMF and position statistics.
info.training: 110 labelled cycles in Train.csv. Timestamp cadence threshold fit on the initial 77 cycles.
info.validation: Chronological final 33 cycles: IoU-weighted F1 1.000, macro F1 1.000; boundaries exactly matched held-out labels. Gap-based segmentation assumes the supplied stream acquisition pattern.

info.name: Rail Balanced Random Forest
info.description: Learned recording-level class from full-resolution channel statistics; no per-bearing diagnosis.
info.training: 272 labelled training recordings; stratified class counts: {np.str_('Normal'): np.int64(234), np.str_('Side I'): np.int64(14), np.str_('Side II'): np.int64(24)}
info.validation: Stratified held-out 55 files: accuracy 0.964, balanced accuracy 0.778, macro F1 0.826. Few minority-class validation files; unseen-route generalization is unknown.

info.name: SHM log-damage ridge regression
info.description: Learned cumulative-damage regression using stress moments and rainflow range moments; no physical location inference.
info.training: 64 labelled healthy-condition stress recordings. File identifiers are excluded.
info.validation: Random held-out 16 files: MAPE 4.152%, score max(0, 1−MAPE) 0.958, MAE 0.00655016. Healthy-condition data only; no fault classification or lifetime estimate.

info.name: ACV case-relative Extra Trees ranker
info.description: Ranks all eight exact car identifiers using observed temperature residuals and control context. Internal scores are not calibrated probabilities.
info.training: Six labelled cases, eight cars each. Car identifiers and case filenames are excluded from feature vectors.
info.validation: Leave-one-case-out across six cases: mean rank-decay score 0.958; top-1 4/6. Extremely small heterogeneous sample; ranking quality remains uncertain.
